scope: Independent read-only review of selective RegMean derive.py and build.py, plus deterministic CPU toy verification. No checkpoint was built and no behavioral evaluation was run.

formula.update: E = delta F F^T (F F^T + T T^T + G G^T + epsilon I)^-1
formula.dual_factorization: X=[F,T,G], J=[I;0;0], C=(X^T X+epsilon I)^-1 J, Y=XC, E=(delta F)Y^T
formula.normalization: Each F/T/G block is divided by sqrt(number of columns), so each block contributes a mean covariance.
formula.assessment: Correct. The implementation never forms a d by d inverse and preserves W_H exactly on the orthogonal complement in FP64.

construction_cv.selection_inputs: Frozen construction rows only; the six evaluation contexts are not loaded by derive.py.
construction_cv.folding: For each inherited fold, training excludes that fold and held-out blocks contain only that fold. Generic text anchors are training-only and are omitted from held-out healthy blocks.
construction_cv.cost: For fs+: ||E X - delta X||^2 / ||delta X||^2. For fs- and healthy: ||E X||^2 / ||delta X||^2. The three ratios are summed, then averaged equally over 24 writers and inherited folds.
construction_cv.baselines: W_H has exact cost 1; the unrestricted donor has exact cost 2.
construction_cv.selection: Minimum construction-CV cost over the three frozen alphas; exact ties choose the stronger ridge.
construction_cv.interpretation: This ranks research candidates. It is not an admission criterion or evidence of behavioral efficacy.

build_review.edited_tensors: Exactly the 24 declared residual writers in layers 12 through 23.
build_review.preserved_tensors: All other Holo tensors remain sourced from the frozen Holo checkpoint.
build_review.arithmetic: The FP64 low-rank update is added to Holo and cast once to the stored dtype.
build_review.provenance: The factor hash and construction metadata are copied into the checkpoint manifest.
build_review.assessment: PASS for producing a research checkpoint. Exhaustive post-build tensor verification and behavioral efficacy remain separate nodes.

limitations: BF16 rounding can introduce an off-subspace component; exact nullspace preservation applies to the FP64 requested update.
The CV ratios are energy-weighted within each held-out stratum, so high donor-response examples contribute more than weak-response examples.
A lower construction-CV cost does not establish the user behavioral gate or online task success.
build.py records embedded source hashes but does not independently revalidate them before materializing the checkpoint; the post-build verifier must check factor provenance and all preserved tensors.
